title: Read the experience list contract
preconditions: The local app is running against the isolated seeded database.

steps.expected: The response has total, page, limit, totalPages, and experiences; experiences holds one record and total matches the seeded count.
Every returned record matches the query in company, role, department, or candidate name, and total drops below the full count.
The response reports page 2 and returns the second slice of records.
total is 0 and experiences is an empty array rather than an error.
